title: dsniff through 2.5a2 contains an integer underflow in decode_sniffer() in decode_sniffer.c that allows unauthenticated…
description: An integer underflow vulnerability exists in dsniff through version 2.5a2 within the decode_sniffer() function in decode_sniffer.c. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to send a specially crafted UDP datagram to port 2001 on a monitored segment, causing a buffer overflow by writing past the global obuf buffer. Exploitation can lead to memory corruption and crash of the dsniff process.
